name: Euler Characteristic Summation
description: Replaced the global structural index (vertices minus edges) with a mathematically equivalent local degree summation. For any forest, the sum over active vertices of (2 - active_degree) equals twice the number of connected components. Setting this sum to 2 is exactly equivalent to requiring the active subgraph to be a single connected component. This hides the connectivity requirement and prevents models from recognizing the minimum subtree objective.
